newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Reynolds rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Reynolds rated a buy.

text.p: ING Barings recommended on Thursday a buy on Philippine aluminium maker Reynolds Philippine Corp up to 5.50 pesos.
The issue closed unchanged at 4.50 pesos at the Philippine Stock Exchange on Thursday.
"We see upside to at least 5.50 pesos," ING Barings said in a research paper distributed to clients.
ING Barings said prospects are bright for the aluminium maker. The company "offers a play on the robust construction and consumer sectors with products used in a variety of applications," it said.
Philippine per capita usage of aluminium is 0.34 kg per annum as against 4.0 kg in Thailand, 3.5 kg in Malaysia and 0.8 kg in Indonesia.

ING Barings said Reynolds would benefit from increased demand of aluminium cables due to the massive expansion of the country's telecom and power industries and plans of two local beverage companies to set up canning facilities.
